title: The Lady in the River and feast of Fairies
content: I used AI to help recreate a dream to help describe a reoccurring dream. &#x200B; In that dream I come across an abandon town nestled in the mountains. for some weird reason I always go swimming in this abandoned town. A black haired women who always jumps in when I'm looking away. her smile always draws me in. I feel comforted and drawn in. We walk a trail into the mountains and into a cave where there's a feast with fairies waiting for us. Its always welcoming and joyous, I always feel happy in that moment and when the sun rises sadness overcomes for I know the dream is coming to an end I get a last look at the longtime friends and hope to see them soon. &#x200B; &#x200B; [The feast](https://preview.redd.it/5b6ombrtj70c1.jpg?width=1024&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=26cab83947af9ee02758981bb7042b34a9a7f126) &#x200B; [The Lady in the river](https://preview.redd.it/3hdra7vvj70c1.jpg?width=1024&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=a1ea57cca73eba4eec2a4b7863c2701154d6b73f) &#x200B;
